## The problem

What are you trying to do that quickhouse doesn't support today? Concrete use
cases help — e.g. "sync from <source> to <destination>", "authenticate with X",
"a knob to control Y".

## Proposed solution

What you'd like the API/behavior to look like (a sketch of the `sync(...)` call
or class is great).

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you've tried, or other approaches.

## Additional context

Source/destination engines, scale, and anything else relevant.
